summary: Tested and fixed data isolation bug in Demand Studio Social Media endpoints. The bug caused posts from ALL shared organizations to show when viewing own account. Fixed by removing membership aggregation that merged all company IDs. Also found and fixed a secondary bug: 'company_filter' was undefined in get_social_stats endpoint (should be 'company_id'). All 13 tests now pass.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Data isolation fix verified working. Key changes: 1) All 5 endpoints (posts, calendar, stats, insights, ideas) now use simple {'company_id': company_id} queries instead of aggregating all company IDs from memberships. 2) Fixed secondary bug in get_social_stats where 'company_filter' was undefined (changed to 'company_id' on lines 3452 and 3461). User's own company_id is 'company_3ab116c0994d'. Shared org tested was 'company_cfab77cb94c1'.

rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: The get_social_stats endpoint had a typo where 'company_filter' was used instead of 'company_id'. This was likely a leftover from a previous refactoring where the variable name was changed but not all references were updated.
